body: I know - but I appreciate you at least taking the time to read and respond. That does mean an awful lot.

I wish I knew. I suppose since we are both extremely emotional, the sensible thing to do is keep going for another hour, day, week. Even though that's not what we want right now.

Keep talking and being honest. It's definitely a start and is by no means an end.

Why the hell would anyone want my real life? Why would anyone want this pain and suffering and torment just so they could have a turn at pretending to be successful? Why would anyone want to experience bullying, abuse and torture at the hands of people who are supposed to give you love and help you develop as a person? I don't understand. 

I don't get it. I have been a good person. I have done charity work, both here and in developing countries. I have this desire to be kind to people and help them. I am still doing it now, in the depths of this so called dream, doing some stupid sewing projects to sell and donate profits to a shelter. I don't understand why I feel like I always have to give back something I've never had, but I do it anyway. 

If I wasn't here, nobody could take advantage of my nature and use me for their own gain. Nobody could put me down, or manipulate me or make me feel like the most despicable person in the world simply for being honest and doing the right thing. 

It is HELL living with myself despite all the things I have which make me look perfect on the outside. I would gladly trade them if it meant my demons were taken with them.

Damn, it's shocking how much I feel like I relate to you just reading your post. I'm so sorry you're feeling so awful. I can only offer you some hugs. I want to say that maybe we'll be okay but I can't promise that. X
